positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on a tool that allowed traders to see market orders through live and cached data. Worked on a team to write the backend for the tool in C++, and then connect the frontend and improve the UX/UI using React.js. After, worked on a tool that automated build processes for developers. During the company's hackathon, worked on a team of four to create an oil trading simulation game, for the company's use at conferences such as Grace Hopper, as well as superdays and the website.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on creating a fund dashboard using React.js on the frontend and Falcon and RethinkDB on the backend, for the company, that allowed the fund manager to directly update token balances. Developed grpc services and tested with Locust.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Taught one week classes to children aged 10-12, over the course of 7 weeks. Taught Java Programming using Minecraft Library Data as well as Java basics up to for and while loops.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked under Dr. Ryan Williams, in the lab of Daniel Heller. Researched carbon nanotubes and usage as sensors for cancer
